sloka: न चैतन्मे प्रियम् पुत्र शपे सत्येन राघव ।छन्नया छलितस्त्वस्नु स्त्रुया छन्नाग्निकल्पया ॥२-३४-३६॥
transliteration: na caitanme priyam putra śape satyena rāghava ।channayā chalitastvasnu struyā channāgnikalpayā ॥2-34-36॥

translations.english: I swear by truth, O my beloved son, that your departure to the forest is in no way a pleasure to me. With a hidden motive, this woman who is like fire concealed by ashes has duped me.
